concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-api-explorer-balanceplatform-webhooks-latest-post-balanceplatform-balanceplatformpayoutschedule-updated]] — 2026-09-15-captured platform-level managed payout schedule update event, with optional schedule settings and a schedule-ID field description that does not prove account-level application or payout execution.
warnings: The raw schedule-ID description mentions a balance account, while the event trigger is a balance-platform schedule update. Do not equate the two scopes.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-api-explorer-balanceplatform-webhooks-latest-post-balanceplatform-balanceplatformpayoutschedule-updated]] — 2026-09-15-captured webhook for a managed payout schedule updated on the balance platform; optional frequency, amount and retained-funds fields describe settings, not execution or bank receipt.
